description: §61.2 — an `<endpoint>` opener attribute whose name is outside `endpoint-attrs ::= path-attr method-attr accepts-attr cors-attr?` (here a misspelled `cor="*"`, with a well-formed value) is E-ENDPOINT-ATTR-INVALID. It is refused rather than ignored: read and ignored, the endpoint would compile with no CORS.
rationale: §61.2: "An `<endpoint>` opener attribute whose name is not `path`, `method`, `accepts` or `cors` — whatever its value … — is `E-ENDPOINT-ATTR-INVALID` (§61.9), reported at that attribute."
